title: Interconnect Architect MCP capability pack
summary: Internal Model Context Protocol tooling that translates engineering intent into controlled interconnect backend operations.

dates.note: First inspected milestone: 2026-04-21. See facts for earlier/later feature stages; this is neither proof of first-ever work nor a formal role/leadership start or shipped release date.

facts.text: Built ia-mcp, an internal Python MCP interface used by several engineers to translate interconnect intent into backend API calls with typed plans, checkpoints, semantic validation and backend fallback.
Introduced the ia-mcp capability pack and developed its planning, execution, compatibility, packaging and acceptance infrastructure.
Future goals include configuration-generation coverage/feature testing and potentially replacing configuration-generation tools.

Introduced the internal MCP capability pack in April 2026 and developed transactional planning, compatibility and packaging through later 2026 changes; the inspected code supports bounded engineering automation rather than a new model execution loop.

notes: Internal engineering use is established qualitatively; exact adoption counts, release dates, productivity savings and external deployment are not established.
Does not establish unrestricted autonomous generation, general autonomous DRC repair, a hosted LLM service or authorship of Codex.

2026-10-27 local Git/source research supplements prior evidence. Authorship supports attributable implementation; shared components and later colleague changes retain separate ownership. No employer tests were rerun.
